title: Your 401(k) Limit Just Went Up for 2027
description: The IRS raised the 2027 employee 401(k) contribution limit to $25,500, up $1,000 from $24,500 in 2026 (IR-2026-136, Nov 12, 2026). A hypothetical extra $1,000 a year at 7% for 30 years could grow to about $94K; plans vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #401k #personalfinance #shorts

title: Michael Dell Started With $1,000 in a Dorm Room
description: In 1984, 19-year-old Michael Dell started PC's Limited with $1,000 from his University of Texas dorm room. By 1992, at 27, he was the youngest CEO on the Fortune 500. #michaeldell #entrepreneur #shorts
